Hi Liam — great to hear from you and glad the demo lined up with your perf targets. Short answer: yes, we typically offer a migration credit and a couple of packaging paths depending on how Aurora wants to balance capex vs opex. High-level options below; I'm attaching a draft license matrix for clarity.

Option A — Pilot Starter (low upfront, shorter commit)
- Reserved node bundle sized to your 60% workload estimate
- Platform fee amortized over 12 months (higher per-month)
- Migration credit: up to 15% one-time credit applied to first 6 months
- Support: Standard (SLA, 8x5 email + 4 hrs/week engineering retainer)

Option B — Enterprise Commit (preferred for cost predictability)
- Larger reserved capacity with lower unit pricing
- Platform fee amortized over 24 months (lower monthly)
- Migration credit: 20% applied across first 12 months (or one-time credit if preferred)
- Support: Premium (24x7 alerting + 12 hrs/week SRE retainer + onboarding)

Notes: Procurement constraints (max amortization window, vendor credit accounting) will impact whether we present the credit as an upfront one-time credit or as amortized monthly bill credits. If you can share a target ARR/commit level, I can run a quick reconciliation to recommend which option is better financially.

Next step: I propose a short call with procurement + our finance lead to align on acceptable amortization and discount structure. I'm available Thu or Fri afternoon PT.

Thanks,
